name: io.github.kisasa/populi-mcp
title: Populi
description: Populi API v2 for student information systems: search the API, read data, optionally write

environmentVariables.name: POPULI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Populi instance URL, with or without the /api2 suffix

environmentVariables.name: POPULI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Populi API key token (Account & Settings > API > Keys). Use an sk_sandbox_ key against a sandbox instance while evaluating

environmentVariables.name: POPULI_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable the populi_write tool (create, update, delete). Default is read-only

environmentVariables.name: POPULI_FILES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for downloads and uploads (the only place files are read from or written to). Default ~/populi-mcp-files

environmentVariables.name: POPULI_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds, 1000 to 600000. Default 120000
